title: 设计模式：记录页「配置页签」并入设计模式，列表视图按钮改名「重置 / 更新视图」（照 Twenty 归类）
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

① product defect · Source: maintainer (Warren), 2026-11-23, UI review thread.
- 13:49Z, asking whether other metadata has the #36692 problem: 「我们除了报表编辑，还有仪表盘编辑，是不是都有类似的问题。」
- 14:23Z: 「还有哪些元数据可能会有问题？同时全面的测试 studio的各项功能」
- 15:08Z, ruling on the decision card 「配置页签和列表保存视图，怎么和设计模式分开？」 → **「照 Twenty 归类」**. The card defined that option as: Configure tabs joins design mode and saves with the same top bar; a list's save-to-view is mutually exclusive with design mode, the same as dashboards and reports.
- 15:12Z, correcting the Twenty reading for item 2: 「tweetty 编辑布局时，列表视图还是正常显示保存」. Verified in Twenty: the list view's save stays live during layout customization. Item 2 below follows Twenty.

Round-2 report: https://claude.ai/artifact/X5ukNAgphAq5vDpDAT6SAD

**What happens (measured on main 9e0c0c23, showcase app, admin, browser).**
1. **Configure tabs × design mode.** Steps: open an account record (`showcase_account`), then ⋯ → 「配置页签」, then 编辑应用. The result is two identical purple bars stacked, 「设计模式 取消/保存」 above 「配置页签 取消/保存」. The reverse order (design mode first, then ⋯ → 配置页签) stacks the same way: the entry is still offered in design mode.
   - Screenshot: project files `ui-review-2026-11-23/round2/r01-设计模式叠配置页签-两条紫色横条.png`.
2. **List draft × design mode.** In design mode on the task list (`showcase_task`), change the sort. The list's 「放弃 / 保存」 appears under the design-mode bar's 「取消 / 保存」. That Save offers 「保存到此视图」, which writes the shared view when the reader may write it.
   - Screenshot: `round2/r02-设计模式里改列表排序-两套保存.png`.

**The model to follow: Twenty (twentyhq/twenty main 86bde5cd, read).** Its layout customization, the one blue top bar, covers record page layouts as well as navigation:
- `layout-customization/hooks/useSaveLayoutCustomization.ts` saves the page layouts listed in `activeCustomizationPageLayoutIdsState` with the same Save.
- `RecordPageLayoutEditModeProvider.tsx` turns record pages editable while `isLayoutCustomizationModeEnabledState` is on.

Content editors stay separate and exclusive, as recorded on #36692.

**Change (the ruled option).**
1. **Configure tabs becomes part of design mode.**
   - While design mode is active, a record page's tab row is the tabs editor in place. Today that is `RecordTabsEditor`, entered via `useRecordTabsConfig` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordTabsConfig.tsx`.
   - Its draft is staged with the design mode's other changes, and the design-mode bar's 保存 / 取消 save or drop it.
   - The separate 「配置页签」 bar (`RecordTabsConfigBar`) and its ⋯ entry are removed: today it is offered at `views/RecordDetailView.tsx` around line 5356 (`RECORD_TABS_CONFIG_ACTION`).
   - Keep the save paths: own-package `relatedLists`, and the installed object's `.custom` extension (`recordTabsConfigSave.ts`, `recordTabsInstalled.ts`). They are called from the design mode's save instead of from their own bar.
   - Keep the existing gates: admin, desktop full page, not a drawer or pane, and the customization-door wall.
2. **A list's view actions stay in design mode, renamed so they no longer read as a second page save.** *(Amended 2026-11-23 15:12Z; see the amendment comment.)*
   - As in Twenty, a list's draft actions stay available while design mode is active. A view is its own thing and saves on its own. In Twenty main 86bde5cd, the view bar's 「Reset / Update view」 (`views/components/UpdateViewButtonGroup.tsx`) has no layout-customization check.
   - Rename them: 「放弃 / 保存」 becomes 「重置 / 更新视图」 (Twenty: "Reset" / "Update view"). The split menu keeps 「保存为我的视图」. The labels are in `views/ListDraftActions.tsx`, mounted at `views/ObjectView.tsx` around line 961.
   - There is no 编辑应用 refusal for a held list draft.

**Expected.** Design mode shows one page-level Save/Cancel set. A list's view actions read as view actions (「重置 / 更新视图」), not as a second page save. Record tab arrangement is a design-mode change, saved with the menu and header changes in one press.

**Acceptance.**
- Tests pin the following:
  - In design mode, the record page's tab row is editable, and the ⋯ menu has no 「配置页签」.
  - Design mode's 保存 writes the tabs draft, for both an own-package object and an installed object's `.custom` extension.
  - Design mode's 取消 drops the tabs draft.
  - The list draft actions read 「重置 / 更新视图」, and the split menu keeps 「保存为我的视图」.
  - The list draft actions still show while design mode is active.
- Browser screenshots of the showcase app show:
  - an account record in design mode with the editable tab row and a single bar;
  - the task list in design mode after a sort change, with 「重置 / 更新视图」 under the design-mode bar.

**Order.** After #36692, which is queued with the same file surface: `SidebarAppMenu.tsx` and the design-mode state. The seat dispatches the two serially, not in parallel. Part of the design-mode epic #36359.

**Relation to #36692.** Both cards change who may be open at the same time as design mode. They touch overlapping files (`SidebarAppMenu.tsx`, design-mode state), so the seat should order or fold them by its file-surface overlap check.

**Skills/docs.** Update any docs or skills page that teaches 「配置页签」 as a separate entry. Search `content/docs` and `skills/` for `Configure tabs` / `配置页签`.

Grading (proposed): `area:build` · Bug · two stacked Save/Cancel bars with no indication of what each saves, hit by every admin who arranges record tabs or adjusts a list in design mode ⇒ p2. The seat grades by its own table. Evidence: measured (screenshots) + read (code on main 9e0c0c23; Twenty source).

Dedupe: check for an open card on `RecordTabsConfigBar` / 「Configure tabs」 or on design mode with list drafts before filing.
